meta.title: FlightGear objects on the wing skin moved onto the new true-dimension wing (tools/build_structure_wing.py)
meta.frame: raw AC3D frame: meters, +x aft, +y up, +z left; translate applied in world space; no rotations needed (all moves < 0.2 m, surfaces locally parallel)
meta.method: contact objects: the vertex nearest FlightGear's skin is mapped by meta.refit of c172p-structure-wing-3d.json (z / 1.025, same fraction of the local depth), snapped to the nearest point of the new skin and offset along its normal by its old stand-off; the LE light group moves with its lens centroid under the refit rule and the new LH outer skin has an opening for it
meta.endpoints_note: positions of the electrical endpoints of data/cockpit-parts.json after the move (fg_light position when given, else object centre); strobes use their nav-light housing
meta.not_moved_note: the FlightGear strut is drawn inside the fuselage object and keeps its place; its upper end now enters the deeper wing (fitting on the strut bolt in c172p-structure-wing-3d.json)
